final: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase_summary AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS station_count FROM station_averages GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandwidth_usage, station_count, CAST(station_count AS REAL) / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS station_fraction FROM phase_summary
